get_resource_path: get the file path to a resource in the d2go tests resources directory
skip_if_no_gpu: skip a GPU test function when no CUDA device is available on the machine
enable_ddp_env: enable a distributed data parallel environment for testing with a specified backend
tempdir: create a temporary directory that is automatically cleaned up after a test function completes
review_helper: review the d2go testing helper module and its decorators for GPU and DDP test support
